title: Fix Paper settlement deadlocks and Legacy backfill timeouts
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Fix the two production defects established by the requested server, betting and log inspection: repeated Legacy historical-accounting candidate-query timeouts and transient PostgreSQL deadlocks during Paper settlement persistence.
inScope: Make GetHistoricalPaperFakFeeBackfillCandidatesAsync select fills through the exact strategy's bounded order set and existing paper_order_id index before evaluating parity exclusions, while preserving all current candidate semantics and cursor ordering.
Retry Paper market-resolution settlement only after PostgreSQL deadlock SQLSTATE 40P01, reloading open positions and rebuilding the complete settlement batch on every attempt.
Add focused unit/source-contract and PostgreSQL integration coverage for the two fixes.
Run focused tests, solution build, requirement validation, independent semantic review, task bookkeeping, task-only commits and push.
outOfScope: Changing any strategy, threshold, signal, stake, order, fill, PnL, fee formula, Maker-GTD execution semantic, Paper/Live classification or Live submission behavior.
Increasing the 10-second Legacy backfill command timeout, adding or changing PostgreSQL schema objects or indexes, or changing the backfill batch size, ordering, cutoff, cursor or eligibility rules.
Retrying non-deadlock settlement failures, replaying a previously built settlement batch after a deadlock, or changing settlement financial calculations.
Writing to Production, deploying, restarting the service, modifying Production configuration, or applying a database migration.
Fixing unrelated dashboard, ETH LossDiff history-backfill, historical parity, queue, performance-projection or repository-wide test failures.
scope.periodOrFilter: Production evidence window 2026-08-28 04:39 through 06:42 UTC; implementation applies only to Legacy Paper FAK fee-backfill candidate reads and Paper market-resolution settlement persistence.
scope.firstVerification: Use read-only Production SQL and EXPLAIN with statement_timeout 15s to identify the exact failing strategy, candidate counts, existing indexes and current query plan before editing.

requirements.text: Remove the verified Legacy candidate-query timeout without changing which historical Paper FAK fills are eligible or changing the timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: The candidate query materializes the exact strategy's eligible Paper orders, then performs parameterized paper_fills lookups by paper_order_id before any historical parity anti-join.
The existing cutoff, fee status, two execution sources, full three-field cursor, fallback/parity/terminal exclusions, chronological ordering and pageSize+1 limit remain unchanged.
The 10-second command timeout, batch size and database schema remain unchanged.

A read-only Production EXPLAIN ANALYZE equivalent for strategy b7c50005-0000-4000-8197-000000000005 uses ix_paper_fills_order_time and completes within the existing 10-second budget; pre-edit evidence for the proposed shape was 145.804 ms for 4,304 strategy orders and zero eligible Legacy fills.
Existing candidate paging, eligibility, idempotency and parity-guard PostgreSQL integration tests continue to pass.

verification.evidence: Focused HistoricalPaperFakFeeBackfill tests passed 21/21 with zero failures and zero skips against the allowlisted disposable PostgreSQL 17 database pct_codex_skip_v2_20260828100500_a6c74e33. It completed in 158.846 ms, returned zero candidates, used ix_paper_fills_order_time for 4,304 parameterized loops, and contained zero sequential-scan nodes on paper_fills. No Production data was written.

requirements.text: Make Paper settlement resilient to the verified transient PostgreSQL deadlocks without risking stale-position overwrite or retrying unrelated failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Only PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 40P01 is retried; cancellation and every other exception are propagated without retry.
Settlement makes at most three complete attempts, with bounded 50 ms then 100 ms delays before attempts two and three.
Every retry reloads the current open positions and reconstructs settlement writes; it never replays writes built before the deadlock.
Exposure cache updates occur only after a successful database commit, and existing settlement PnL, fee and idempotency semantics remain unchanged.
Intermediate deadlocks are logged as warnings with attempt and phase; an exhausted third deadlock remains an error and is rethrown.
Focused tests prove one-deadlock recovery, two-deadlock recovery, third-deadlock exhaustion, no retry for non-deadlock errors, position reload on each retry and cancellation-aware delay.

verification.expected: All Paper settlement processor tests pass, including exact deadlock retry boundaries and full position reload behavior.
verification.evidence: PaperSettlementProcessorTests passed 7/7 with zero failures and zero skips. The focused cases prove one- and two-deadlock recovery, full reload after deadlock, third-attempt exhaustion, no retry for non-deadlock failure, and cancellation-aware retry delay.

requirements.text: Deliver only the two approved resilience fixes with complete local verification and no Production mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Every governed changed path maps to REQ-001 or REQ-002; unrelated dirty user files and behavior remain untouched.

Requirement validation passes and an independent reviewer compares the verbatim requests, approved contract, actual diff and verification evidence with no open findings.
No Production write, deployment, service restart, configuration change or database migration is performed in this task.
